author: Patrick Xjr
text:
Good morning 
The purpose of sensor is different from finger blood.
Our target is to stay within the limits (70-180). So we have to adapt our meals.
In fact first thing to do is to make a lot of trials:
In example white bread, is to be limited in quantity in order not to go over 180. You have to chose the bread and to limit daily quantities .
In fact diabetic people can eat all types of food but we have to limit quantities of glucose.
On the contrary we can eat vegetables as we want in term of quantities…
We need nearly one year in order to understand how our body reacts ( as we are different persons this has to be an individual step)
Good luck on the good path
